Class ParamSet

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.nn.ParamSet
public final class ParamSet extends Object
All parameters of one network. Weights are shared between threads (read-only while gradients are being computed); every worker thread owns its own gradient buffers from newGrads().

    • read

      public void read(DataInputStream in, int insertAt, int inserted) throws IOException
      Loads a network saved before inserted new inputs were added at position insertAt of an input vector. Layers fed by that vector have fewer rows in the file; their rows are moved to the new positions and the rows for the new inputs start at zero, so the loaded network behaves exactly as it did until it learns to use them. With inserted == 0 every tensor must match exactly.
      Throws:
      IOException
